title: Imala Lubbuu Guddifamte
intro: Yeroo seera hawaasaa ol’aantummaa qabanitti, namni dhuunfaa adda ta’e tokko maatii eebbifame keessatti jijjiirama guddaa argateera. Seenaan isaanii, hidhata jaalalaa fi labsii Waaqayyootiin kan mallatteeffame, duudhaawwan durii cabsuu fi seera bu’uuraa haaraa fi qajeelaa ta’an hundeessuun agarsiisa. Seenaan kun barbaachisummaa dhugaan walgahii irra qabuu fi ogummaa ajaja Rabbii duuba jiru kan mul’isudha.
clues: Yeroo tokko boojiʼamaa ture, garuu qophii Waaqayyootiin manaa fi maatii haaraa argadheera.
Baayʼee jaallatama waanan tureef, maatii dhalootaan koo fi guddifachaa guddifachaa koo gidduutti filannoo yeroon naaf kennamu isa lammaffaa wajjin turuu filadhe.
Maqaan koo yeroo tokko eegduu guddifachaa koo wajjin kan wal qabate siʼa taʼu, kunis gocha hawaasa koo keessatti baramaa ture.
Nabiyyii dhumaa kan maqaan isaa ifatti Rabbiin Qur’aana keessatti kaase ana tokkicha.
Dubartii kabajamtuu ilma obboleessa Rasuulaa taate fuudhe, garuu gaa'elli keenya hin turre.
Erga wal hiikee booda Rabbiin ofii isaatii haati manaa koo duraanii Nabiyyii akka heerumtu murteessee, kanaanis aadaa durii guddifachaa ilaalchisee ture akka hin hojjenne taasiseera.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
